title: Sir Nange Phupiyan Maawan De Vaikhe Abid Ne
body:
Sir Nange Pupiyan Mavan Day Vekhe Abid Nay
<<DIVIDER>>
Haye Shaame Valay Khooni Manzar Keevian Vekhe Abid Nay
<<DIVIDER>>
Sir Sangaan Tey Char Key Hai Lashan Nai Paiyan
Bemaar Hi Jane Kiwein Dafaan Ey Hoiyaan
Haye Shaam Tai Pyou Dey Qatal Kiwein Vekhe Abid Ney
<<DIVIDER>>
Gal Touq Tey Behri Bemaar Dey Kaariyaan
Takh Shaam Nu Akhiyaan Taiyo Louh Diyaan Jahriyaan
Wich Bazaaran Dey Haste Shaami Kiwein Vekhe Abid Ney
<<DIVIDER>>
Teri Qaid Ey Vakhri Na Rowi Sakina
Tu Khakh Tey Souna Nahi Ey Babe Da Sina
Haye Sabaar Tere Bhain Meri Kiwein Vekhe Abid Ney
<<DIVIDER>>
Tur Duniya Toh Challeya Jera Khoon Si Ronda
Ajj Vella Akhiri Koi Apna Tey Honda
Haal Baqir Dey Hai Yateema Wale Vekhe Abid Ney
<<DIVIDER>>
Koi Qaidie Momin Mumtaz Na Howe
Be Warissaan Wangou Pardes Na Rowe
Haye Ghairaat Dey Zaghme Sare Kiwein Vekhe Abid Ney
